request: Remove verifyToken from bearerAuth and require a fixed token instead, so authentication setup is easier to inspect.

source.request: Remove verifyToken from bearerAuth and require a fixed token instead, so authentication setup is easier to inspect.
source.settled: Bearer authentication accepts a verification function through verifyToken, including an asynchronous function.
source.why: Requiring a fixed token would remove callback-based token verification.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
